plus)](https://github.com/Marvisak/VIctory/compare/main...AntoninMichelq:VIctory:up/firstlane-phi?expand=1&title=Shaders%3A+trace+per-lane+descriptors+through+the+VGPR+phis+that+join+them&body=%3C%21--+claude-projects-attribution%3A+%7B%22github_login%22%3A%22AntoninMichelq%22%7D+--%3E%0A_Requested+by+%2A%2A4nto%2A%2A+%C2%B7+%5Bproject+thread%5D%28https%3A%2F%2Fclaude.ai%2Fcode%2Fproject%2Fchan_01XYoPEzLL1bj63HP9pniGvs%3Fthread%3Dcmsg_01XYoPEzLL1bj63HP9pniGvsYRPS2v37oeDeGaCHT7dFsi%29_%0A%0A%23%23+Summary%0A%0APer-lane+descriptors+are+now+traced+through+the+VGPR+phis+that+join+them.+Tracing+used+to+stop+there+with+%22a+descriptor+read+from+the+first+lane+of+a+phi%22.%0A%0AA+waterfall+loop%27s+descriptor+is+often+held+in+VGPRs+that+phis+join%3A%0A%0A-+carried+unchanged+through+a+loop%2C+through+copies+the+phis+do+not+see+through%3B%0A-+loaded+in+the+two+branches+of+an+if%2Felse+on+EXEC%3B%0A-+reloaded+in+some+passes+of+an+outer+loop.%0A%0AThis+PR+builds+on+the+waterfall+lowering+in+the+%60up%2Fwaterfall-descriptors%60+branch.+Its+first+two+commits+are+that+branch%2C+unchanged.+Only+the+last+commit+is+new+here.%0A%0A%23%23+What+changed%0A%0A-+%60resource.rs%60%3A%0A++-+The+tracer+follows+VGPR+phis.+A+phi+whose+arguments+all+come+to+one+dword+%28through+other+phis+and+%60v_mov%60+copies%2C+ignoring+self-references+and+VGPRs+no+instruction+wrote+on+some+path%29+is+that+dword.%0A++-+Other+joins+become+%60Source%3A%3APaths%60%3A+one+source+per+predecessor%2C+chosen+by+the+path+each+lane+takes+into+the+block.+After+structurisation%2C+EXEC+branches+are+per-lane+branches.%0A++-+%60Source%3A%3ACarried%60+stands+for+a+loop%27s+back+edge+to+the+join+being+traced.+%60Source%3A%3AUnset%60+stands+for+VGPRs+never+written+on+a+path.+These+are+listed+in+%60Waterfall%3A%3Aunset%60%2C+and+lowering+refuses+them+if+the+hardware+loads+them.%0A++-+Arguments+that+cannot+be+traced+fail+with+their+own+reason+%28LDS+read%2C+input+VGPR%2C+...%29.%0A-+%60emit%2Flower.rs%60%3A+%60Paths%60+becomes+a+DXIL+phi+of+each+predecessor%27s+heap+index%2C+computed+at+the+end+of+that+predecessor+%28filled+after+all+blocks%2C+for+back+edges%29.+It+is+used+through+%60createHandleFromHeap%60+with+%60nonUniformIndex%60.+A+per-lane+descriptor+loaded+under+a+partial+EXEC+%28a+guarded+load+in+an+if%2Felse+without+%60s_cbranch_execz%60%29+now+fails+instead+of+giving+every+lane+the+loaded+index.%0A-+Junk+edges%3A+in+the+game%27s+joins%2C+one+predecessor+usually+brings+a+real+descriptor+%28an+%60s_load_dwordx4%60+from+a+table%29+and+the+others+bring+VGPRs+that+cannot+be+one+%28computed+values%2C+a+buffer+load%2C+an+input+VGPR%29.+Lanes+on+those+edges+never+reach+the+access.+Such+paths+become+%60Source%3A%3ANoDescriptor%60+%28heap+index+0%29%2C+as+long+as+at+least+one+other+path+is+a+real+descriptor.+LDS+reads+are+not+counted+as+junk.%0A-+First-lane+reads+outside+a+waterfall+loop%3A+a+descriptor+whose+%60v_readfirstlane_b32%60+results+are+not+all+compared+with+each+lane%27s+own+dwords+in+the+same+loop+is+not+a+waterfall.+The+console+uses+the+first+active+lane%27s+descriptor+for+every+lane%2C+so+the+lowering+does+the+same%3A+the+handle+index+is+%60WaveReadLaneFirst%60+of+the+per-lane+heap+index%2C+read+where+the+console+reads+the+dwords%2C+and+the+handle+stays+uniform.+Compares+of+those+reads+outside+a+loop+lower+as+a+compare+of+heap+indexes.+A+loop+that+compares+only+some+of+the+dwords+still+fails%2C+because+the+hardware+result+there+cannot+be+reproduced+from+heap+indexes.%0A-+%60apps%2Fvictory%2Fsrc%2Ftranslate.rs%60%3A+the+tally+covers+the+new+%60Source%60+variants+%28%60Fetched%60%2C+%60Select%60%2C+%60Lanes%60+from+the+waterfall+commits%2C+and+%60Paths%60%2C+%60Carried%60%2C+%60Unset%60%29.+Without+this%2C+%60cargo+check+-p+victory%60+does+not+build+on+top+of+the+waterfall+commits+alone.%0A-+%60docs%2Farchitecture.md%60%3A+a+short+note+on+phi+joins.%0A%0A%23%23+How+it+was+tested%0A%0A-+%60cargo+test+-p+victory-shader%60+%28Linux%29+passes%3A+76+tests%2C+including+new+tracer+tests+%28a+loop-carried+phi%2C+an+if%2Felse+join%2C+a+descriptor+replaced+in+a+loop%2C+one+joined+from+LDS%2C+joins+with+junk+edges%2C+first-lane+reads+outside+a+loop%29+and+lowering+tests+for+a+load+under+a+partial+EXEC+and+for+first-lane+reads+outside+a+waterfall.%0A-+%60cargo+check+--tests+-p+victory-shader+-p+victory-gpu%60+and+%60cargo+check+-p+victory%60+for+%60x86_64-pc-windows-msvc%60+%28with+%60CARGO_FEATURE_PURE%3D1%60%29+pass.%0A-+On+the+game%27s+26%2C148+shader+programs%2C+on+an+integration+stack+that+includes+this+change%2C+%22a+descriptor+read+from+the+first+lane+of+a+phi%22+went+from+294+programs+to+0.+The+programs+that+still+stop+now+stop+later%2C+on+other+reasons%3A+computed+VGPRs+%28138%29%2C+a+buffer+load+%28124%29+and+an+input+VGPR+%2811%29.%0A%0A%23%23+Where+3D+rendering+stands+on+an+RX+7600+%28Windows+11%29%0A%0A-+In+the+world%27s+first+cutscene%2C+props%2C+characters%2C+cables+and+vehicle+tyres+render+%28seen+in+a+G-buffer+view%29.%0A-+The+first+lights+now+show+in+the+lit+image+%28flares%2C+lens+streaks+and+some+lit+areas%29.+Most+of+the+lighting%2C+plus+ground%2C+roads%2C+buildings%2C+textures+and+sky%2C+is+still+missing+or+black.%0A-+No+GPU+hang+in+the+latest+world+runs+of+several+minutes.+About+10%2C000+draws+per+frame%2C+at+well+under+1+fps.%0A%0AThese+observations+come+from+the+integration+stack+%28upstream+main+plus+many+open+PRs%29%2C+not+from+this+branch+alone.%0A%0A%F0%9F%A4%96+Generated+with+%5BClaude+Code%5D%28https%3A%2F%2Fclaude.com%2Fclaude-code%29%0A%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fclaude.ai%2Fcode%2Fsession_01AZ9pSB4ZoXYUifuXg8gm66%0A)
